title: Jake
platform: Roblox Studio (R15 Avatar Standard, UGC Marketplace)
requirements: Development of standard R15 layered apparel assets for the multiplayer sci-fi adventure game. Project required modeling an intricate scientist lab coat from scratch to comply with rigid caging systems. Specifications detailed custom inner and outer cages, specific identification badges, a specialized headlamp accessory, and designated non-texture zones to allow dynamic in-game team customization.
achievements: Engineered double-layered cage meshes complying fully with the Roblox Avatar Standard
Optimized geometry to sub-4,000 polygon limit while maintaining crisp shape fidelity
Implemented a multizone material shader that allows runtime script-driven color adaptation
review: Incredible asset creation pipeline. Our layered apparel fit perfectly over all player avatars without clipping.
